import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    target = n // 2 + 1
    nums.sort()
    print(nums[target - 1])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
